update.name: aaa_base
update.summary: openSUSE Base Package
update.description: This package installs several important configuration files and central scripts.

update.name: bash
update.summary: The GNU Bourne-Again Shell
update.description: Bash is an sh-compatible command interpreter that executes commands read from standard input or from a file. Bash incorporates useful features from the Korn and C shells (ksh and csh). Bash is intended to be a conformant implementation of the IEEE Posix Shell and Tools specification (IEEE Working Group 1003.2).

update.name: bash-sh
update.summary: Handle behaviour of /bin/sh
update.description: Use bash as /bin/sh implementation.

update.name: crypto-policies
update.summary: System-wide crypto policies
update.description: This package provides pre-built configuration files with cryptographic policies for various cryptographic back-ends, such as SSL/TLS libraries.

update.name: curl
update.summary: A Tool for Transferring Data from URLs
update.description: Curl is a client to get documents and files from or send documents to a server using any of the supported protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, TFTP, DICT, TELNET, LDAP, or FILE). The command is designed to work without user interaction or any kind of interactivity.

update.name: glibc
update.summary: Standard Shared Libraries (from the GNU C Library)
update.description: The GNU C Library provides the most important standard libraries used by nearly all programs: the standard C library, the standard math library, and the POSIX thread library. A system is not functional without these libraries.

update.name: libcom_err2
update.summary: E2fsprogs error reporting library
update.description: com_err is an error message display library.

update.name: libcurl4
update.summary: Library for transferring data from URLs
update.description: The cURL shared library for accessing data using different network protocols.

update.name: libgcc_s1
update.summary: C compiler runtime library
update.description: Libgcc is needed for dynamically linked C programs.

update.name: libglib-2_0-0
update.summary: General-Purpose Utility Library
update.description: GLib is a general-purpose utility library, which provides many useful data types, macros, type conversions, string utilities, file utilities, a main loop abstraction, and so on.

update.name: libopenssl1_1
update.summary: Secure Sockets and Transport Layer Security
update.description: OpenSSL is a software library to be used in applications that need to secure communications over computer networks against eavesdropping or need to ascertain the identity of the party at the other end. OpenSSL contains an implementation of the SSL and TLS protocols.

update.name: libopenssl1_1-hmac
update.summary: HMAC files for FIPS-140-2 integrity checking of the openssl shared libraries
update.description: The FIPS compliant operation of the openssl shared libraries is NOT possible without the HMAC hashes contained in this package!

update.name: libreadline7
update.summary: The Readline Library
update.description: The readline library is used by the Bourne Again Shell (bash, the standard command interpreter) for easy editing of command lines. This includes history and search functionality.

update.name: libsolv-tools
update.summary: Utilities to work with .solv files
update.description:
libsolv is a library for solving packages and reading repositories.
This subpackage contains utilities to create and work with the .solv files used by libsolv.

update.name: libsolv-tools-base
update.summary: Utilities used by libzypp to manage .solv files
update.description: This subpackage contains utilities used by libzypp to manage solv files.

update.name: libstdc++6
update.summary: The standard C++ shared library
update.description: The standard C++ library, needed for dynamically linked C++ programs.

update.name: libudev1
update.summary: Dynamic library to access udev device information
update.description: This package contains the dynamic library libudev, which provides access to udev device information

update.name: libzypp
update.summary: Library for package, patch, pattern and product management
update.description:
libzypp is the package management library that powers applications like YaST, zypper and the openSUSE/SLE implementation of PackageKit.
libzypp provides functionality for a package manager:
* An API for package repository management, supporting most common repository metadata formats and signed repositories. * An API for solving packages, products, patterns and patches (installation, removal, update and distribution upgrade operations) dependencies, with additional features like locking. * An API for commiting the transaction to the system over a rpm target. Supporting deltarpm calculation, media changing and installation order calculation. * An API for browsing available and installed software, with some facilities for programs with an user interface.

update.name: login_defs
update.summary: login.defs configuration file
update.description: This package contains the default login.defs configuration file as used by util-linux, pam and shadow.

update.name: openssl-1_1
update.summary: Secure Sockets and Transport Layer Security
update.description: OpenSSL is a software library to be used in applications that need to secure communications over computer networks against eavesdropping or need to ascertain the identity of the party at the other end. OpenSSL contains an implementation of the SSL and TLS protocols.

update.name: shadow
update.summary: Utilities to Manage User and Group Accounts
update.description: This package includes the necessary programs for converting plain password files to the shadow password format and to manage user and group accounts.

update.name: zypper
update.summary: Command line software manager using libzypp
update.description:
Zypper is a command line tool for managing software. It can be used to add package repositories, search for packages, install, remove, or update packages, install patches, hardware drivers, verify dependencies, and more.
Zypper can be used interactively or non-interactively by user, from scripts, or front-ends.
